purpose: Adds the Twilight Forest dimension with bosses, loot and a large block set
note: Adds a whole dimension (995 items): boss progression, armor/tool tiers (ironwood, steeleaf, knightmetal, fiery, arctic), naturally generated content, many decorative blocks. Entering needs a portal from the overworld. Not a pillar of any pack; kept for extra things to do (audit: cut if no story role). Built-in support: supported by Bookshelf and Enchantment Descriptions only; nothing else in the pack integrates with it.
